nodes.label: Graphify Knowledge Graph Workflow
nodes.rationale: graphify query/path/explain return a scoped subgraph that is usually much smaller than GRAPH_REPORT.md or raw grep output, so they are preferred for codebase questions; GRAPH_REPORT.md is reserved for broad architecture review or when the scoped tools do not surface enough context.

nodes.label: graphify update .
nodes.rationale: Run after modifying code to keep the graph current; it is AST-only so it incurs no API cost.
